_comment: Pinned source for tools/make-cities.py. The script refuses any file whose SHA-256 or size differs. To update: pick a new natural-earth-vector release tag, re-check LICENSE.md, then update every field here and rerun. The na_fit entries pin the outlines used only to check the U.S. & Canada map projection (same release, same rules).
dataset: Natural Earth 1:10m cultural vectors: populated places
license: Public domain. LICENSE.md at v5.1.2 opens with 'Everything here is public domain.' (verified 2026-10-14)
fallback: https://www.naturalearthdata.com/downloads/10m-cultural-vectors/10m-populated-places/ (zip; .dbf only). Not wired into the script.

na_fit.dataset: Natural Earth 1:50m cultural vectors: admin-1 states, provinces
na_fit.use: main map (states, provinces, D.C.), Hawaii and D.C. insets

na_fit.dataset: Natural Earth 1:50m cultural vectors: admin-0 countries
na_fit.use: territory insets (Puerto Rico, U.S. Virgin Is., Guam, N. Mariana Is., American Samoa)
